prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Jamaican person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome young man's idol face with a clean sharp jawline, straight thick brows and defined expressive eyes, a very faint trace of stubble, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a soft amused smile, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin square-sided cowbell, an iron pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum necklaces. Extra long nails in matching polished rosewood.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body deep purple-brown rosewood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep purple-brown rosewood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID near-black streaks running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Her face stays real living skin and the carving ends cleanly at the neck.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme platform combat boots carved from the same rosewood, the thick platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Thai man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, smooth golden-tan skin, a gentle soft smile, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (an iron hammer head, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver small flared temple bell, a copper square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large, thick, heavy and extremely strong man, far beyond any real person, built like a powerlifter. A huge barrel chest, enormously wide shoulders and back, a thick solid waist with a firm rounded belly over strong abs, massive arms, and enormous thick thighs and calves. Every part is large, dense and continuous rather than sharply cut. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal polished gold metal micro brief of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering him, paired with a black leather chest harness of thin crossing straps with silver ring hardware, his chest and stomach otherwise fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black high-top platform sneakers with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
